versions.changelog:
Initial release — combines comprehensive local mathematical, matrix, statistical, precision, and signal processing computation in one skill.  

- Introduced unified calc.py script with modular subcommands: eval, precision, matrix, stats, optimize, integrate, transform
- Supports symbolic/math expressions, arbitrary precision, matrix operations, statistical analysis, numerical optimization, integration, and signal processing (FFT)
- Uses numpy, scipy, and mpmath for fast and accurate computation
- Includes detailed usage guide, CLI examples, and a complete test suite (`test_calc.py`) with 97 test cases
- Structured output format, support for math constants, and clear error handling
